+/*
+	Patch  : [dbo].[FAM_DepMethod_GetAll] - Lấy danh mục phương pháp khấu hao

+Set Quoted_Identifier On

+Create Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DepMethod_GetAll]

+Begin
+	Set Nocount On;
+	Select
+		FAM_DepMethod.MethodID,
+		FAM_DepMethod.MethodCode,
+		FAM_DepMethod.MethodName,
+		FAM_DepMethod.IsExecutable,
+		FAM_DepMethod.IsActived,
+		FAM_DepMethod.OrderIndex,
+		FAM_DepMethod.Description,
+		FAM_DepMethod.CreatedDate,
+		FAM_DepMethod.CreatedUser,

+		FAM_DepMethod.UpdatedUser,
+		FAM_DepMethod.RowVersion

+	Where FAM_DepMethod.IsActived = 1
+	Order By
+		FAM_DepMethod.OrderIndex,
+		FAM_DepMethod.MethodID

+Go

+/*
+	Patch  : [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_GetByDeviceID] - Lấy chính sách theo tài sản
+	Date   : 2026-10-19
+	Module : FAM
+*/
+Set Ansi_Nulls On
+Go
+Set Quoted_Identifier On
+Go
+If Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_GetByDeviceID]', N'P') Is Not Null
+	Drop Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_GetByDeviceID]
+Go
+Create Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_GetByDeviceID]
+(
+	@DeviceID bigint
+)
+As
+Begin
+	Set Nocount On;
+	Select
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceDepPolicyID,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DeviceID,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MethodID,
+		FAM_DepMethod.MethodCode,
+		FAM_DepMethod.MethodName,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.DepreciationStartDate,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.UsefulLifeMonths,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.IsDepreciable,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningDate,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.MigrationOpeningValue,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.AccumulatedOpening,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.EffectiveFrom,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.StatusID,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.Description,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.CreatedDate,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.CreatedUser,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.UpdatedDate,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.UpdatedUser,
+		FAM_DeviceDepPolicy.RowVersion
+	From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy]

+/*
+	Patch  : [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_HasPostedPeriod] - Kiểm tra khóa chính sách
+	Date   : 2026-10-19
+	Module : FAM
+*/
+Set Ansi_Nulls On
+Go
+Set Quoted_Identifier On
+Go
+If Object_Id(N'[dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_HasPostedPeriod]', N'P') Is Not Null
+	Drop Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_HasPostedPeriod]
+Go
+Create Procedure [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPolicy_HasPostedPeriod]
+(
+	@DeviceID bigint
+)
+As
+Begin
+	Set Nocount On;
+	Select
+		Convert(bit,
+			Case
+				When Exists
+				(
+					Select 1
+					From [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail]
+						Inner Join [dbo].[FAM_DeviceDepPeriod]
+							on FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.DeviceDepPeriodID = FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceDepPeriodID
+					Where FAM_DeviceDepPeriodDetail.DeviceID = @DeviceID
+						and FAM_DeviceDepPeriod.StatusID = 2
+				)
+				Then 1
+				Else 0
+			End) As HasPostedPeriod
+End
+Go
*** End Patch
